text:
Hard Rock Stadium daa August 16, 1987 mu, ɛberɛ a ɛhyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ ɛbɛtumi agye preseason game a edi kan no. Wɔde sika $115 million bɔɔ no, na HOK Sport (a wɔfrɛ no Populous sɛsɛɛ) na ɛyɛɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ; ɛhyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ Joe Robbie Stadium, na wɔfrɛɛ no saa kosi 1996. Efi mfiase no, ɛyɛɛ NFL Miami Dolphins fie, na wɔagye saa adwuma no afi 1987.

Beaeɛ no din abɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ adwuma pii. Wɔde din a wɔtɔ no nti ɛbɛyɛɛ Pro Player Park ne Pro Player Stadium, akyiri no ɛbɛyɛɛ Dolphins ne Dolphin Stadium, Land Shark Stadium, Sun Life Stadium ne New Miami Stadium kakraa bi, na ɛhyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ Hard Rock Stadium wɔ 2016. Nnipa a wɔbɛtenaa mu nso yɛɛ pii: MLB Florida ne Miami Marlins tenaa mu fi 1993 kosi 2011, na wɔdii 1997 ne 2003 World Series nkunimdie wɔ hɔ; Miami Hurricanes abɔɔ wɔn college football afiri 2008, na Miami Open tennis tournament nso afi 2019. Wɔde Tifway 419 Bermuda grass na ɛyɛ agoprama no.

Stadium no su sesaeɛ wɔ 2015-2016 nsesaeɛ mu a Stephen Ross, onipa a ɔwɔ no, na ɔde ne sika boaa ho. Wɔde video board wɔ nkyɛnkyɛn ne suites foforɔ baa mu, na wɔde canopy a ɛda aduasa a ɛda nkyɛnkyɛn spires anan so no hyɛɛ beaeɛ no so, na ɛkata nneɛma a wɔtena so no mu dodow. Nsesaeɛ no maa nnipa a wɔtumi hyɛ mu no fi 75,000 bɛyɛ 65,000.

Akyire no, stadium no agye American sport mu nneɛma akɛseɛ, a Super Bowls nsia ne college football national-championship games pii ka ho. Wɔ mfeɛ a ɛnnɛ yi mu no, ɛde ne ho abɛhyɛ association-football mu yie, na ɛgyee 2024 Copa America Final ne 2025 FIFA Club World Cup nneɛma, a Al Ahly 0-0 Inter Miami a ɛhyɛɛ aseɛ no ka ho. Wɔ 2026 FIFA World Cup no, wɔde din Miami Stadium ahyɛ no den kakraa wɔ FIFA clean-venue naming policy no nti. Ɛbɛgye nneɛma ason: group-stage games anan, Round of 32 baako, quarter-final baako, ne third-place match a ɛbɛyɛ July 18, 2026.
